etymologies.etymologyHTML: From trade +‎ -er.

definitions.definition: One who earns a living by trading goods or securities.

quote.citation: 2023 December 27, David Turner, “Silent lines...”, in RAIL, number 999, page 29:
quote.text: On November 29 1952, a special train ran from Sunderland to Leeds for Christmas shoppers and those attending a Leeds vs. Brentford match. It caused controversy, with Sunderland traders protesting that their shops were just as good as those in Leeds.
